subject: Technical Onboarding Playlist — org & network prep for eval
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Technical Onboarding Playlist — org & network prep for eval

Hi Samantha / Michael,

Great talk this morning — thanks for the open discussion. Per our demo, I’m sharing a compact onboarding playlist to get Orca Health into a short evaluation (POC) running inside your VPC. The MAP below keeps the timeline tight but realistic for the end-of-month close you mentioned.

Top-level asks from our side: API key provisioning, an evaluation org (can be a dedicated Redwood org or a sandbox within your existing account), IP allowlist ranges, and VPC peering details. I’ve attached a lightweight MAP (redwood-map-playlist.xlsx) and a simple checklist so your infra and security teams can iterate against it.

Key milestones (high level):
- Day 0–2: Exchange contact points, share VPC peering CIDR & peering contact, enable primitive firewall rules (allow egress to 34.120.0.0/14 and 52.23.0.0/16 for our peering IPs)
- Day 3–5: Org creation & API key provisioning (short-lived keys for eval, rotation instructions)
- Day 6–10: Load/throughput smoke tests and validation against your dataset (we’ll provide sample prompts)
- Day 11–14: Optional canary run and handoff to your app team

Action items for Orca: fill out the MAP spreadsheet, send VPC peering contact + CIDR, and confirm whether you want a dedicated Redwood eval org or single-tenant sandbox.

I’ll loop Vivek (SRE/infra) on the technical details and Laura on contractual / timeline edge cases. If you want an accelerated schedule we can look at short-term credits or a trial commit — I’ll coordinate internally.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0126

Thanks, Aditya — this looks good. A couple of technical clarifications from our infra/security team before we fill the MAP:

1) IP allowlist: we prefer to whitelist by hostname where possible; can you provide the fully qualified domains in addition to the CIDR ranges? We need to map to our firewall rules and give the change window to ops.

2) VPC peering: our infra lead wants to know whether the peering will be single-direction (Redwood initiates) or a bilateral peering. Also, what is the expected ASN and BGP hint if any?

3) API keys: for POC we’d like short-lived keys (24h) and an automated rotation endpoint. Do you support issuing scoped keys tied to a single org? If so, what roles are available (read-only, inference-only, admin)?

If you can answer those, we’ll complete the MAP and get you the CIDR and peering contact later today.

—Sam
Samantha Lopez
Director of Engineering, Orca Health
s.lopez@orcahealth.ai
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical Onboarding Playlist — org & network prep for eval

Hi Sam — quick answers from infra:

- Hostnames/domains: we publish TLS endpoints under *.api.redwood.ai and a set of regional egress hostnames: us-west.api.redwood.ai, us-east.api.redwood.ai. For your firewall we can provide both DNS names and the recommended egress CIDR blocks. DNS-based allowlisting is fine but we recommend CIDR for predictable peering rules.

- Peering model: we typically request bilateral peering inside the customer VPC (customer peers with our VPC); peering is initiated by the customer side for cloud security reasons and accepted by Redwood. Expected ASN: 64512 (private ASN) and no BGP required for simple route-based peering on AWS — we will share a prescriptive guide.

- API keys: we support scoped keys per org. For evals we provision short-lived (24h or 72h) keys via our internal portal; rotation can be automated via our admin API (token endpoint documented in the attached vpc-peering-guide.pdf). Role types for scoped keys: inference-only, embed-only, admin (org-level). For POC please request inference-only keys and a single admin user for key management.

I’ve attached the VPC peering guide with the exact steps we request (vpc-peering-guide.pdf). If you prefer, I can set up a 30-min SRE alignment call today at 3pm PT.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
